technical.summary: Multiple momentum crossovers (MACD, Stochastic) show early bullish signals, but price remains below key moving averages (EMA21, EMA50, SMA50) and Ichimoku cloud with weak RSI confirmation—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EW shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 61 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 sales, 1 purchase) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (382.8) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 61 days presents moderate event risk for healthcare sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/Stochastic crossovers with Supertrend bullish and extreme fear (21/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support at 104.4 in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages (EMA21, EMA50, SMA50) and Ichimoku cloud with weak RSI confirmation, zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis regime (382.8), and earnings risk in 61 days make this a low-probability swing entry.
